subject: IAM evidence request and SOC 2 status
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: call re: Redwood inference security/compliance

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking the time today — quick follow-up from our side after the call with the platform and security teams. Acme Health is moving this procurement forward and we need a short packet for our security review and procurement checklist. Specific asks from today: 

- SOC 2 status (Type II or in-progress) and the most recent summary report or attestation.
- Confirmation of support for SSO (SAML) and any metadata/cert artifacts you can share.
- SCIM provisioning support (SCIM v2, attributes supported, provisioning/deprovisioning behavior).
- RBAC / admin controls overview (admin roles, ability to restrict access, audit logging).
- Point of contact for any vendor questionnaire items (we have a security questionnaire due by 2027-04-16).

If possible, can you send a single bundle (PDF + a few screenshots) we can attach to our packet? Appreciate an ETA by early next week so procurement can stay on track.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Director of IT Security, Acme Health
jordan.lee@acme-health.com
(555) 555-1212

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-health.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: call re: Redwood inference security/compliance

Hi Jordan — great to meet you earlier. Thanks for the clear list; I want to summarize next steps so we're aligned: 

1) We will provide a single evidence package that includes: SOC 2 Type II summary (scope & date), SSO/SAML metadata, SCIM provisioning notes + screenshot, and a short RBAC/admin controls doc.

2) Aditya (cc'd) will pull the artifacts and include brief explanations of behavior (e.g., SCIM attribute mappings, default admin vs. custom roles).

3) Neha is on the procurement enablement team and will help with a one-paragraph statement you can paste into your contract packet confirming Redwood's security posture.

ETA: We'll aim to get the package to you by Monday (2027-04-12). If you need anything earlier, call out the procurement questionnaire items and we'll prioritize those.

Action items for you: if there are specific questionnaire fields (e.g., "Is SSO supported?" or "Provide encryption at rest details"), paste them into a reply and we'll answer inline.

I'll follow up when we upload the files.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-health.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: call re: Redwood inference security/compliance

Hi all — attaching the initial evidence stubs below. These are attachments (PDF/DOCX/PNG) — see attachment list at the bottom. I'll upload high-resolution copies to a shared drive if you prefer. Short answers inline: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in-scope for the inference platform (control environment, change management, logical access). Attached is a one-page summary and attestation date. Full report can be provided under NDA/procurement request.

- SSO / SAML: We support SAML 2.0, exchange metadata XML, and rotate signing certs per rotation schedule. We can provide an SP metadata file and sample IdP mapping guidance. Support for OIDC is also available.

- SCIM: We support SCIM v2 for user provisioning and deprovisioning. Typical mappings: userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type eq "work"]. We support Group-to-Role mappings via SCIM groups. Rate limits and provisioning cadence are documented in the attached screenshot.

- RBAC / admin controls: We provide role-based scopes (Admin, Billing Admin, Developer, Read-only). Admin roles can be restricted by org and by team. All admin actions are audit-logged; audit logs are available via the Console and also via API export.

Point of contact for questionnaire: me (aditya.rao@redwood.com) — happy to go line-by-line.

Attachments (stubs): SSO_SAML_config.pdf (SP metadata + mapping), SCIM_provisioning_screenshot.png, RBAC_admin_controls.docx, SOC2-type2-summary.pdf

Let me know if you want the SOC 2 full report — we can route under an NDA.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Security & Compliance Engineering, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-health.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acme-health.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: call re: Redwood inference security/compliance

Marissa/Aditya — received, thanks. The artifacts look good at a glance. A few quick items from procurement/security: 

- Can you provide a one-paragraph confirmation we can paste in the vendor packet that states: Redwood Inference supports SAML 2.0 SSO (SP metadata available), SCIM v2 for provisioning, role-based access controls with audit logging, and maintains SOC 2 Type II compliance (summary attached)?
- For any questionnaire items, procurement has prepended a short list — I'll paste them below in a separate email. Could Aditya be the primary responder?

If you can send the one-paragraph confirmation and a point-of-contact line today, we'll be able to complete internal sign-off ahead of 2027-04-16. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Jordan
